'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian forces]] repel an attempted [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] crossing of the [[Donets]] river, west of [[Sievierodonetsk]], in [[Luhansk Oblast]]. At least one [[battalion tactical group|Russian battalion tactical group]] is reportedly destroyed, as well as the [[pontoon bridge]] deployed in the crossing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-forces-prevented-attempted-russian-river-crossing-donbas-britain-says-2022-05-13/ (Reuters)]
***The [[Russian Air Force]] launches around a dozen [[missile]]s at the city of [[Kremenchuk]], including four at the [[Kremenchuk Oil Refinery]], in [[Poltava Oblast]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3481727-eight-to-twelve-russian-missiles-hit-poltava-regions-kremenchuk.html (Ukrinform)]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[Turkey]] says that five people were injured by [[Kurdish nationalist]]s launching a missile attack into the country from [[Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/five-wounded-turkey-hit-by-rockets-fired-syria-ministry-2022-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*One person is killed and thirteen others injured by a [[roadside bomb]]ing targeting a van in [[Karachi]], [[Sindh]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-bombings-karachi-45d299b6982481b73236b12888b62666 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[cryptocurrency]] market loses [[United States dollar|US$]]200 billion following [[stablecoin]] TerraUSD's collapse in value. [[Bitcoin]] and [[Ether (cryptocurrency)|Ether]] fall to their lowest value in 16 and 11 months, respectively. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/05/12/bitcoin-btc-price-falls-below-27000-as-crypto-sell-off-intensifies.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tibet Airlines Flight 9833]]
**An [[Airbus A319|A319-100]] aircraft operated by [[Tibet Airlines]] [[Runway excursion|veers off the runway]] and catches fire at [[Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport]] in [[Yubei District]], [[Chongqing]], [[China]], injuring forty people, with some being hospitalized. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2308894/chinese-plane-catches-fire-at-airport-all-passengers-evacuated (''Bangkok Post'')] [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/chinas-tibet-airlines-plane-with-122-people-veers-off-runway-catches-fire-over-40-injured/article65406496.ece (''The Hindu'')]
*Five people are feared dead and twenty others are injured in a [[chemical plant]] [[explosion]] and fire in [[Kočevje]], [[Slovenia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/explosions-slovenia-ljubljana-68f368fe7ff5030ed8a4a37782e75c67 (AP)]
*Eleven people die and thirty-one others are rescued after a boat [[capsize]]s off the coast of [[Puerto Rico]] near [[Desecheo Island]]. [https://apnews.com/article/immigration-puerto-rico-0e1f67149a9fbce830a5a5860cbbe48e (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Korea]]
***[[North Korea]] announces its first [[COVID-19]] outbreak. [https://apnews.com/article/covid-health-pandemics-south-korea-north-0e0cb1be7a3878a771124dcdcbdba06c (AP)]
***[[Supreme Leader (North Korean title)|Supreme Leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] orders a national lockdown. [https://www.ft.com/content/41dec58c-3860-4ae3-86c4-716ffe85dbdd (''Financial Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]	
***[[Romania]] announces that starting on May 16, the fourth dose of Comirnaty &ndash; the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] &ndash; can be administered in vaccination centers and in family medicine offices for all adults. [https://www.romania-insider.com/romania-fourth-covid-dose-may-2022 (Romania Insider)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Finland–NATO relations]]
***[[Finland]]'s leaders declare that the country should apply for membership of [[NATO]] "without delay," with the [[Parliament of Finland|Parliament]] set to vote next week on whether to apply. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/05/12/finland-announces-bid-to-join-nato-in-historic-move.html (CNBC)] [https://www.presidentti.fi/en/press-release/joint-statement-by-the-president-of-the-republic-and-prime-minister-of-finland-on-finlands-nato-membership/ (President of the Republic of Finland)]
**[[Finland–Russia relations]]
***The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] threatens to take retaliatory steps against Finland, including of a "military-technical" nature, if the country joins NATO. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-61420185 (BBC News)]
*[[France–Iran relations]]
**[[France]] summons the [[Iran]]ian [[ambassador]] in response to the detainment of two French nationals. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/2-french-citizens-detained-in-iran-paris-calls-for-their-immediate-release/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*A team of scientists at the [[Event Horizon Telescope]] release the first ever image of [[Sagittarius A*]], the [[supermassive black hole]] at the center of the [[Milky Way]] [[galaxy]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-61412463 (BBC News)]
*Researchers from the [[University of Florida]] announce that plants have been grown on [[lunar soil]], collected by [[Apollo program|Apollo]] missions, for the first time ever. [https://apnews.com/article/space-exploration-science-technology-florida-46313ab85b13f33ff6767f75b98e9c47 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]], [[2022 French Open]]
**Tennis players from [[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] will be allowed to compete at the upcoming [[French Open]] as neutral athletes. However, players who speak in support for [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] will face sanctions. [https://www.tennismajors.com/roland-garros-news/mauresmo-says-russian-players-welcome-at-roland-garros-but-warns-of-sanctions-in-case-of-pro-putin-statements-598826.html (Tennis Majors)]
